verdict: Classic 2022 SaaS explainer: floating tilted browser windows sliding as a carousel on a lavender blob gradient (sheet_1 frames 165-450).
No hard cuts at all; everything is slide/dissolve, so scene detection returns 0 (ffmpeg scene>0.3).
Each view is identified by a coloured header bar plus pill icons with an animated pointer, not by zooming.
Includes a stock-footage person-at-desk comp (frames 95-165), a pattern DemoForge should avoid.
Ends on logo + URL + CTA button card with cursor hover (frames 450-570).
